svg.title: Downloads
svg.desc: GitHub release downloads per day of jdx's tools, averaged over the 7 days to Oct 8, CI included: hk 104,714 (23% week over week), fnox 42,099 (26% week over week), usage 33,613 (5% week over week), aube 28,779 (86% week over week), mr boxington 26,552 (new), pitchfork 16,057 (46% week over week). jdx tools combined 26% week over week, all of mise 49%.

g.text: release downloads · 7-day average to Oct 8 · CI included
jdx tools +26% · all of mise +49% WoW
GitHub release downloads from mise-analytics, CI included. Every asset counts, so one install can be several downloads and these
are not unique users. Installs through npm and Homebrew aren't counted here.
